product: Open-source and low-cost CAD alternatives (FreeCAD 1.0/1.1, LibreCAD 2.2, QCAD CE/Pro, BRL-CAD, nanoCAD Free, CADCraft/ArtCraft)
summary: Across review sites and issue trackers (2024-2026) the free CAD field is judged on one question: do the office's real DWGs open exactly and come back clean. Every product fails it somewhere: LibreCAD maintainers say DWG support is 'still being implemented' (2.2.2-alpha); QCAD puts DWG behind the ~$50 Pro edition; FreeCAD's DXF/DWG path has silent export failures and it is widely called 'not an AutoCAD replacement' for 2D; CADCraft opens more DWGs than LibreCAD per a LibreCAD user, but BricsCAD V26 refused 14 of 23 CADCraft-saved DWGs and AutoCAD AUDIT finds errors after a round trip. Stability is the second theme: FreeCAD has 362 crash-titled GitHub issues since 2025-01-01 and topological naming is mitigated, not solved; LibreCAD logged 37 (mostly fixed fast; 2.2.1.6 is a crash-fix release); CADCraft has GPU-specific startup failures, an xref re-path crash and a reproduced silent data loss when two instances save one DWG. Performance on 5-50 MB drawings and xrefs is third (CADCraft: 47.8 MB DWG 20-28 s and ~4.5 GB; a 77 MB xref peaks at 8.4 GB). Praise is consistent: free, lightweight, fast maintainer response, QCAD's simplicity and one-time price, nanoCAD's AutoCAD-like ease (G2 8.9 vs 8.3). No open-source CAD offers civil objects except FreeCAD's one-developer Trails add-on; site designers use QGIS as a complement and Blender-GIS (~9.5k stars) for terrain. Caveat: Capterra/G2/AlternativeTo/QCAD-forum numbers are from search snippets (pages unreachable); SourceForge and GitHub figures were read live on 2026-10-21; Reddit/HN could not be opened.

aggregate_ratings.rating: 4.1/5; ease of use 7.6-7.8/10, import 8.3, export 8.4, support 8.0
not captured; summary theme 'frequent bugs and instability'
4.2/5; ease of use 8.9 vs AutoCAD 8.3; support 7.7 vs 8.2
5.0/5; lists 'starting at $180 per user per year', free version available

aggregate_ratings.site: GitHub (CADCraft, interest proxy; no G2/Capterra/AlternativeTo listing found)
aggregate_ratings.rating: n/a; ~6.3k stars, ~2.8k forks, 57 watchers, 392 open issues, Discussions disabled, eight releases on the Releases tab (v0.1.0 to v0.10.0) (reconciled after the fact-check and critique, 2026-10-21)

praise.detail: The dominant positive across SourceForge and Capterra: 'drafting features comparable to paid programs at no cost' (LibreCAD, Capterra value 4.2/5); FreeCAD 'comparable to the other major CAD packages' once learned; BRL-CAD reviewers thank devs for the free licence.

praise.theme: LibreCAD: lightweight 2D that reads DWG well enough for floor plans
praise.detail: 2023-2026 SourceForge reviews: 'lightweight and practical', reads DWG, used for floor plans/sections and woodworking/construction layouts shared between PCs; 'excellent program that works well' (2024).

praise.theme: FreeCAD 1.0/1.1: the big complaints finally addressed
praise.detail: 1.0 (Nov 2024) shipped TNP mitigation, integrated Assembly, materials and UI/UX work (501 GitHub reactions); 1.1 (25 Mar 2026) adds Part Design previews, draggers, lighting, FEM animation (284 reactions). Long-time users report file recovery and 'no particular crash problems since 0.14'.

praise.theme: QCAD: simple, intuitive, honest one-time pricing
praise.detail: G2 4.4/5 praises 'simplicity and ease of use'; Pro is CE plus DWG/polyline/viewport/scripting plugins for roughly $50 one-time with one year of updates; developer states Pro and CE render identically. Reviewer: edits DWG/DXF without AutoCAD cost, light on resources.

praise.theme: nanoCAD: AutoCAD muscle memory plus native DWG
praise.detail: G2 ease-of-use 8.9 vs AutoCAD 8.3; 'praised for its similarity to AutoCAD'; permanent-licence option and familiar commands cited.
'Superb' documentation, reliable and fast for precise coordinate-based solid modelling, database-connected models.

praise.theme: CADCraft: maintainers answer fast and ship fixes within a day
praise.detail: A Discord report of a PC freezing on a big DWG (Oct 12) got v0.6.2 the next day: hatch memory blow-up and single-core rendering fixed; four 5-16 MB permit drawings went from an 8 GB ceiling to <1.5 s and 84-600 MB; reporter confirmed the freeze is gone. Community runs real-file corpora and sends PRs.

praise.theme: CADCraft: opens more DWGs than LibreCAD (external user)
praise.detail: A LibreCAD issue reporter (Oct 2026) says CADCraft 'has many bugs but opens more DWG files' than LibreCAD, which 'often fails to open DWG files, sometimes opens them empty'.

~9.5k-star add-on imports shapefiles, GeoTIFF DEMs, OSM, web basemaps and SRTM, georeferences scenes and builds Delaunay terrain; evidence that terrain/context modelling has moved to Blender rather than to open CAD.

complaints.detail: 362 GitHub issues with 'crash' in the title created since 2025-01-01 (no Crash label exists, so title search is the proxy); October 2026 reports hit TechDraw, Sketcher, STEP export, stylesheets, Part Design pad/fillet, Assembly joints, Spreadsheet on macOS and packaging (bundled NumPy SIGILL on older CPUs). Capterra's summary theme is 'frequent bugs and instability'.

complaints.theme: FreeCAD topological naming mitigated, not solved
complaints.detail: Issue #29154 (Apr 2026, 1.1 dev): shortening a pad flipped a sketch dimension and broke pockets, chamfers and fillets; a member says TNP 'can be mitigated but not fully fixed'; V2 algorithm (PR #31040) still in progress; 8 of 19 toponaming issues since 2025 remain open.

complaints.theme: FreeCAD is not a 2D drafting / DWG replacement
complaints.detail: AlternativeTo commenters: 'no drafting functionality worth speaking of', 'certainly not an AutoCAD replacement'; 122 DXF-tagged issues since 2025 incl. automatic DWG export failing silently (#31835), DXF import leaving a stuck busy cursor (#31637), points not exported (#30675), importer scaling text wrongly (#30043).

complaints.theme: FreeCAD civil/geomatics is a fragile one-developer add-on
complaints.detail: Trails workbench (83 stars, 22 open issues, LGPL) offers survey import, surfaces, sections, volumes and LandXML alignments but packaged releases lag the dev branch, submodules are required, documentation is thin, and GIS integration is 'nascent'; the Road fork explicitly has no GIS tools.

complaints.theme: FreeCAD learning curve, confusing panels, thin support
complaints.detail: G2 ease of use 7.6-7.8/10; reviews cite undocumented sketch-attachment rules and a UI 'frustrating compared with Inventor and Creo'; 2026 discussion: panel controls 'confusing, state-dependent'; a switcher from AutoCAD notes 'near no customer service'.

complaints.theme: LibreCAD DWG support incomplete and not a project goal
complaints.detail: Maintainers on #3064 (Oct 2026): DWG 'still being implemented for 2.2.2-alpha and LibreCAD_3'; contributor suggests converting to DXF with an online converter; 4 of 20 DWG issues since 2025 still open; comparison sites list DWG as import-only. On #3162 a contributor says 'cloning AutoCAD has never been the project's goal'.

complaints.theme: LibreCAD reader fragility and crashes (fixed quickly)
complaints.detail: PR #2855 (merged 2026-09-14): a reader change on master opened only 28 of 1,483 test DXFs including LibreCAD's own saves and the whole parts library, before the fix restored 1,482. 37 crash-titled issues since 2025 (paper size, moving a hatch, copy/paste between files, undo/redo, block edit, macOS); 2.2.1.6 (Oct 2026) is largely a crash-fix release and 2.2.1.5 added a crash handler.

Lowest-rated SourceForge review: no integrated help, online manual 'hard to find, incomplete, inaccurate'; Capterra support 3.1/5; print preview correct but nothing printed on US Letter; 'printing setup is a pain'. No 3D, no xrefs.

CE lacks DWG, polylines, viewports and scripting (Pro plugins); after the one-year update window Pro cannot pick up new CE core features without renewing; Pro trial is session-limited; support 7.7/10 from a very small vendor. Review base is tiny (13 on G2).

complaints.theme: nanoCAD Free: thin support, limited free tier, status unverified
complaints.detail: G2 support 7.7 vs AutoCAD 8.2; 'no comparable feature to AutoCAD's dynamic updating'; an anecdotal comment says the free edition is 2D-only; whether a free edition is still offered in 2026 could not be verified (vendor site unreachable).

Command-line-heavy, 'clunky' interface; 'hard to make simple changes', no easy fillets, doubtful IGES/STEP results (CATIA-trained engineer); install requires compiling, 'for Linux experts' (2022); 6 one-star reviews. Robust geometry alone did not win drafters.

complaints.theme: CADCraft performance and memory on real DWGs and xrefs
complaints.detail: #1076: 47.8 MB DWG (985k entities) takes ~19.6 s headless, 22-28 s to appear, peaks 4.5-5.1 GB on an M1 Pro; intermediate DXF text 5.8x the input is built fully in memory. #1625 (0.8.0): a 76.8 MB xref attached to a 39.9 MB plan freezes the window 34 of 90 s and peaks at 8.4 GB; no human reply. #752: 'even mouse movement is choppy', whole PC freezes; AutoCAD handles files 4x larger smoothly.

complaints.theme: CADCraft DWG fidelity: files other CAD refuse or audit-fail
complaints.detail: #1041 corpus (23 office DWGs, 1.63M entities, v0.6.2): ODA and ezdxf read all output, but BricsCAD V26 refused 14 of 23 CADCraft-saved DWGs (assoc constraints, dynamic-block evaluation graphs); lost draw order (~2,680), annotative context (~957), ~95% of DIMASSOC, ~half of FIELDs, 2,575 of 2,580 3DSOLIDs; ~410 AUDIT messages per 5-layout drawing. #604: AutoCAD 2027 round trip went from 0 to 6 AUDIT errors and AC1032 became AC1018. #907: BricsCAD RECOVER breaks both layouts. Also #1463 layouts merged, #1321 empty viewports/wrong fonts, #1316 viewport UCS dropped, #1812/#1813 Aspire crashes on import.

complaints.theme: CADCraft crashes and startup failures in the field
complaints.detail: 42 issues match 'crash': black/unresponsive window on 0.7.0 with Intel Ivy Bridge GPU (#1724, dup #1824: 0.6.0 worked), Metal device-lost on older Macs (#1631), SIGILL on quit (#1536), crash on resize (#1527), Mali/ARM64 (#1454), Raspberry Pi 5 (#955); XREF crash after re-pathing a missing 22 MB xref on Windows 11 while 'another CAD program opened the same file without complaint' (#1636, critical, no human reply); DWGs fail to open on macOS 27 (#1421). README itself notes wgpu OpenGL can crash some AMD setups before the window appears.

complaints.theme: CADCraft silent data loss on concurrent save; lossy saves
complaints.detail: #540: a user reproduced silent data loss on 0.6.2 (Flatpak/Debian) when two instances saved the same DWG; asks for conflict warnings, external-modification detection, single instance per drawing. README: entities not yet modelled are dropped on save, SHX fonts not read. Contributor: autosave/recovery/per-instance locks exist; .bak backups, fsync-durable saves and 'who has it' are missing.

complaints.theme: CADCraft input model and UI vs AutoCAD habits
complaints.detail: #1001: clicks lost while the mouse is moving in TRIM/STRETCH/LINE/MOVE/COPY and window selection; users must stop before clicking (fix PR #1555 under review). #729: panels cannot dock, Layer Properties Manager floats over the canvas, no saved workspaces. #1134: constraint tools existed but were undiscoverable; Fix did not hold a point; visibility checkbox inverted. Also no interactive DIMSTYLE (#850), PLOT dialog missing (#429), right-click Enter (#1387), printing in non-inch units broken (#1828).

22 issues match xref: crash on re-path (#1636), 8.4 GB freeze (#1625), XCLIP boundary ignored (#1581), xref layer overrides lost on save (#886, fixed), LISP cannot identify xref blocks (#1716), REFEDIT/REFSET/REFCLOSE landed for blocks (#813); editing an xref in place is still open, raster references not listed (#1756).

complaints.theme: CADCraft feedback loop loses the reporter
complaints.detail: Bug reports arrive via Discord and are relayed by a bot; reporters often have no GitHub account so replies never reach them (#752, #1636, #1824, #738); several maintainer replies are labelled as written by Claude Code on a contributor's behalf; Discussions are disabled.

complaints.theme: No open-source civil/site stack; QGIS is a complement
complaints.detail: Guides describe QGIS as 'an open-source GIS platform rather than a CAD application' used alongside Civil 3D for catchments and mapping, lacking grading/corridor/drafting tools; surveyors prefer Carlson for daily work but must hand files to Civil 3D users. Only FreeCAD Trails offers surfaces/alignments in open source.

wishes: Open the office's real DWGs (2004-2018, xrefs, layouts, dynamic blocks, associative constraints) exactly, and save files that AutoCAD and BricsCAD open with zero AUDIT errors and no version downgrade (cadcraft #604, #1041, #907; LibreCAD #3064).
Never silently drop entities, xdata or draw order on save; warn before any lossy write and keep the original untouched (CADCraft README caveat; #540).

Stay smooth on 20-50 MB drawings and multi-xref plans: background loading, visibility culling, first paint under ~12 s, peak memory under ~2.5 GB (#1076, #1625, #738; 'AutoCAD handles files 4x larger').

Zero crashes plus real recovery: atomic fsync-durable saves, .bak files, recovery journal, single-instance-per-drawing locks, conflict detection, and AUDIT/RECOVER equivalents (#540, #752; LibreCAD 2.2.1.6 crash list; FreeCAD 362 crash issues).
Robust startup on any GPU with a software/fallback renderer when Metal/Vulkan/DX12/OpenGL fails (#1724, #1631, #955, README AMD note).

AutoCAD-compatible muscle memory: command aliases, right-click Enter, clicks registered while the mouse moves, familiar selection, DIMSTYLE and PLOT dialogs, dockable panels and saved workspaces (nanoCAD ease score; #1001, #729, #850, #429; LibreCAD #3162).
Proper external references: relative paths, re-path without crashing, clipping, in-place edit, overrides preserved, raster images listed, fast load (#1636, #1581, #813, #886, #1756, #1625).
Reliable plotting in any unit and paper size with a working preview (#1828, #1791; LibreCAD printing reviews).
Integrated, current help and a support channel where the reporter actually sees the answer (LibreCAD docs reviews, Capterra support 3.1/5; CADCraft Discord relay).

Native site-work objects instead of a lagging add-on: TIN surfaces, contours, alignments/profiles, CSV/LandXML point import, coordinate systems and GIS layers (FreeCAD Trails status; QGIS-as-complement).
A public real-file test corpus with per-release round-trip reports and AUDIT counts (cadcraft #1041 offer; LibreCAD PR #2855 method).
Linux/macOS parity with signed installers, no compile-it-yourself (LibreCAD unsigned DMG note; BRL-CAD reviews).
A funding model users already accept: one-time ~$50 Pro with a year of updates (QCAD) rather than subscription.

key_claims.claim: FreeCAD 1.1.0 was published on GitHub on 25 March 2026 (project blog dates the release 24-25 March 2026) and drew 284 reactions on the release post.
SourceForge's FreeCAD project page shows a 4.5/5 rating from 124 reviews, with 12 one-star reviews, and no reviews dated 2025 or 2026.
SourceForge's LibreCAD project page shows 4.7/5 from 77 reviews (67 five-star, 3 one-star), with the newest review dated 2026-03-29.

LibreCAD's latest stable release is 2.2.1.6 (October 2026), a crash-fix release; no 2.2.2 or 3.0 stable has shipped, and maintainers said in October 2026 that DWG support is still being implemented for 2.2.2-alpha.
FreeCAD's GitHub tracker lists 362 issues with 'crash' in the title created since 2025-01-01 (as of 2026-10-21), and toponaming issue #29154 (April 2026) remains open pending a V2 algorithm.

In a community corpus test (23 office DWGs, 1.63M entities) BricsCAD V26 refused 14 of 23 DWGs saved by CADCraft 0.6.2, and an AutoCAD 2027 round trip produced 6 AUDIT errors and downgraded AC1032 to AC1018.
Capterra rates LibreCAD 4.0/5 from 48 reviews (support 3.1/5, value 4.2/5).
G2 rates QCAD 4.4/5 from 13 reviews and nanoCAD Free 4.2/5 from 23 reviews, with nanoCAD Free ease-of-use 8.9 vs AutoCAD 8.3.
QCAD Professional costs roughly $50 one-time with one year of updates; the Community Edition lacks DWG, polyline and viewport features, which are Pro plugins.
SourceForge's BRL-CAD project page shows 4.4/5 from 49 reviews with 6 one-star reviews, the newest dated 2022-04-28.

The storytold/cadcraft GitHub page showed about 6.3k stars, 2.8k forks and 392 open issues on 2026-10-21, with Discussions disabled and eight releases on the Releases tab (v0.1.0 of 8 Oct 2026 to v0.10.0 of 21 Oct 2026); 393 open issues and 405 open pull requests per the fact-check.
A CADCraft user reproduced silent data loss on 0.6.2 when two instances saved the same DWG; a 76.8 MB xref peaks at 8.4 GB and freezes the window on 0.8.0.
The FreeCAD Trails workbench repository has 83 stars, 22 open issues and warns that packaged releases lag the development branch; BlenderGIS has about 9.5k stars.
